name: citybar
description: 策研组（Ceyan Group）· 城市规划与文旅策划 AI 专家组

plugins.name: project-positioning-strategist
plugins.description: A project planning and positioning consultant that helps architects and urban designers clarify a project, run foundational analysis, define its positioning, and produce concrete theme, function, business-mix and operations planning during conceptual design.

plugins.name: ppt-outline-architect
plugins.description: Converts a project planning/positioning report into a structured, presentation-ready PPT outline and page-by-page script for downstream AI production.

plugins.name: business-logic-reviewer
plugins.description: A business-logic reviewer that audits a project planning/positioning report for closed-loop logic, internal consistency and real market support, backed by evidence-graded research — issuing issue-by-issue findings and actionable fixes without fabricating data.

plugins.name: copy-polisher
plugins.description: A copy polisher that turns draft slide copy into natural, human-sounding Chinese: removes AI-writing tells with a cluster-based detection rule, corrects domain terminology, matches tone and style to the audience — without touching figures, conclusions or structure.

plugins.name: visual-design-architect
plugins.description: A visual expression designer that turns a polished slide script into an executable visual system: design tokens, a page-type library, per-page layout blueprints, SVG samples and an image requirement list — emitted as a ppt-master compatible Design Spec so a downstream generator can build fully editable slides without guessing.

plugins.name: ppt-producer
plugins.description: A PPT production expert that drives the local ppt-master pipeline to turn a locked design spec and polished slide copy into a fully editable native PPTX first draft, enforcing fact discipline, editability hard rules, deviation logging and a page-level gap list instead of inventing content or polishing prematurely.

plugins.name: ppt-refiner
plugins.description: A PPT refinement and finalization expert that converges a first-draft deck into a deliverable one: it runs objective visual checks page by page, aligns deck-wide consistency, strengthens expression only on the pages that matter, lays out manually added image pages under the project's visual rules, and re-verifies editability before signing off. It never redesigns, never rewrites copy and never touches numbers.

plugins.name: project-orchestrator
plugins.description: A project flow director that stitches the specialist experts into one project: it drafts the project charter (shared hard rules for every expert), hands off a routing pack at each handoff point, and runs a gate check on every deliverable before the next step starts. It never creates content, never signs off on the user's behalf, and never edits upstream outputs.

plugins.name: ceyan-team
plugins.description: An eight-role project planning and deck studio: it turns a raw project brief into a presentable PPT deck through positioning, business review, outline, copy polish, visual design, first-draft generation and page-level refinement — staged in four checkpoints that stop for the owner's sign-off.
